answer: Sybil tax stops fake identities with a sunk cost: each new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable tax of 50 POA, a walnut to crack once and never again. Honest agents pay once and earn it back in 20 epochs; a forger pays for every fake, and when the tide of registrations surges the tax doubles. Each payment leaves an echo in the ledger, exposing wallets funding hundreds of taxes. Forging 100 fakes burns 5,000 POA for at most 2,000 POA.
